__1 To press out or extract juice.

ind. A particle often used with nouns to form Karmadhāraya and Bahuvrīhi compounds, and with adjectives and adverbs. It has the following senses:-- 
__1 Well, good, excellent; as in सुगन्धि. 
__2 Beautiful, handsome; as in सुमध्यमा, सुकेशी &c. 
__3 Well, perfectly, thoroughly, properly; सुजीर्णमन्नं सुविचक्षणः सुतः सुशासिता स्त्री नृपतिः सुसेवितः … … सुदीर्घकालेऽपि न याति विक्रियाम् [[

.]] 
__4 Easily, readily, as in सुकर or सुलभ q. v. 
__5 Much, very much, exceedingly; सुदारुण, सुदीर्घ &c. 
__6 Worthy of respect or reverence. 
__7 It is also said to have the senses of assent, prosperity, and distress.
